scope: Native Promptfoo integration of NVIDIA's published four-query retrieval example against an existing local vLLM endpoint
classification: Upstream NVIDIA example execution with endpoint-only substitution; local source-derived Promptfoo ranking assertion and browser integration checks

execution.python_environment: Existing vLLM 0.25.0 environment with NumPy and requests

result.usage_status: Unreported by upstream script; Promptfoo zero placeholders do not establish zero usage or zero cost

independent_observation.method: Native vLLM metrics snapshots bracketing the eval command
independent_observation.scope: Model-specific observation window, consistent with eight texts in two HTTP batches; not exclusive per-eval attribution or savings

private_native_json.public_projection: Only the local Promptfoo result UUID was replaced with promptfoo-local-result-1 to meet repository publication policy. Provider output, grading, native metadata and usage placeholders are unchanged.

recovery.rerun_reason: Report detail originally displayed upstream zero usage placeholders without an adjacent explanation; added explicit unknown-usage text to the native test description and reran
recovery.browser_harness_failures: Retained stale-ref error and an incorrect row-count text expectation; recovered using fresh native refs and observed result visibility

limitations: This is the four-query upstream example, not MTEB, held-out retrieval qualification, or a production workload benchmark.
The JavaScript assertion is locally authored from NVIDIA's published query/document pairings and checks rounded printed values.
The upstream program and native HTML export are unchanged apart from the program's endpoint substitution; the Promptfoo configuration is local integration.
The report is an official static HTML export captured at the recorded time, not a continuously refreshed Promptfoo server.
